name: the Relationships finding glyph is drawn by ::after again
why: The reported bug 1a: the finding's ⚠️ and the hover ⟳ shared ::after, so the ⟳ took the ⚠️'s absolute place at the right edge.

name: the hover title handler replaces the finding title with the reload hint
why: The reported bug 1a, tooltip half: the finding text has to stay above the hint.

name: the icon's popup stack carries no finding box
why: The reported bug 1b: the stack showed the link box only.

name: the #mb-stat-tooltip path carries no finding box
why: Without a preview card the icon's box comes from _tipTextToHtml(), a second path that must carry the finding too.

name: the finding box under the card is not in the finding colour
why: The finding box maps to the 'tip' note kind, the one with the amber finding border.

name: the check is Discogs-only again
why: 1c: every host counts, so the x.bandcamp.com cell is the second flagged one.

name: sites are grouped by site kind, not host
why: amazon.de/amazon.com and music./itunes.apple.com are different sites; grouping by _siteFamilyOf() flags them.

name: the ignore list is not read
why: A listed host must never count.

name: the detail names the first site only
why: The user asked for every site involved to be named (two Discogs and two amazon.de: both).

name: the link-preview master switch is not read
why: 2b: off, the engine must not be installed at all.

name: the initial-page preview switch is not read
why: 2b: off, nothing may resolve before a button rendered the table.

name: the initial-page preview switch blocks the rendered table too
why: 2b: once the table is rendered the previews must work as set; the gate is the initial page only.

name: no sidebar handle on the initial page
why: 2c: the handle must be there before any button.

name: the consolidated view's layout CSS lands on the initial page
why: 2c: an open sidebar on the initial page must keep MusicBrainz's layout; the layout rules (margin-right, padding, box-sizing, transitions) are the final phase's only.

name: the render leaves the initial page's open sidebar open
why: 2c: the consolidated view still starts collapsed (sa_sidebar_collapsed) when the handle came from the initial page.

name: the initial page starts per sa_sidebar_collapsed
why: 2c: the initial page has its own start state, open by default; sharing the consolidated view's would collapse it.
